fixes: Closed requests no longer display a waiting-for-proposals message.
Selected proposals show a booking-progress guard instead of a missing-request message.
Frame interactions and route changes are identified outside the app.
Old frame content stays hidden until the requested document loads.
Reselecting and resetting always load a fresh isolated document.
Shared UI cases have explicit explanations; nine missing implemented states were added.
Content-hashed local scripts and styles prevent cached copy/app release mismatches.
Preview readiness requires rendered main content; empty frames are reported as load failures.
Sign-in chooser, email address and verification-code previews added.
scope: Implemented prototype screen states with isolated local fixtures. Live authentication, payment, delivery and map services are not verified.

latestBrowserVerification.method: Select every state through inline IA controls; require rendered main text and exact iframe document URL.
